newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB shares leap to new highs.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB shares leap to new highs.

text.p: Shares in Australia's largest bank, National Australia Bank Ltd, leapt over two percent to a record high A$15.16 on Friday after it announced a share buy-back worth A$1.1 billion.

The bank said it planned to buy back on market up to 74 million shares at a cost of about A$1.1 billion and said it was also working with an investment bank to finalise a new flexible capital instrument that would raise up to US$750 million.
"The shares are up on the buyback, that's why they have run ahead," said a Sydney-based dealer.
The buyback, to be completed in about 12 months, follows a smaller buyback of 13 million shares announced on November 21.
By 11.30 a.m. (0030 GMT), National Australia Bank shares were up 46 cents at A$15.30 on turnover of 10.4 million shares.
